model_output.verdict: A medical ICU nurse with clear patient care experience and room to explain charge and committee work.
write_up: Your resume points to medical ICU nursing, with earlier telemetry experience. A recruiter can see your patient assignments, critical care treatments and Arizona license quickly. The main questions are about what you do beyond direct care, especially as charge nurse and on the sepsis committee.

The line about caring for 2 critically ill patients in a 24-bed medical ICU is a strong model: it names the patients, assignment and unit in one sentence. Both nursing roles also identify their specialties, and your license and certifications are easy to find.

Let's start with the charge nurse line and add what you're responsible for on those shifts. Then give the precepting and committee work a little more room, so a recruiter can see what those roles involve.

cards.line: - Provide direct care for 2 critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this one. It gives a recruiter a concrete picture of your assignment without making them search elsewhere.

cards.line: - Serve as charge nurse two shifts per month
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see how often you're charge nurse, but not what you handle on those shifts. Your responsibilities matter for understanding that work.
cards.example: Serve as charge nurse two shifts per month, handling [charge nurse responsibilities]
cards.question: What are you responsible for when you serve as charge nurse?

cards.line: - Precept new graduate nurses during their ICU orientation
cards.cannot_tell: Precepting is valuable here, but a recruiter can't tell what you teach or guide the new nurses through.
cards.example: Precept new graduate nurses during their ICU orientation on [skills or tasks]
cards.question: What skills or tasks do you guide new graduate nurses through during orientation?

cards.line: - Member of the unit's sepsis bundle compliance committee
cards.cannot_tell: Committee membership names the topic, but not your part in the work. What did you do with the committee?
cards.example: Member of the unit's sepsis bundle compliance committee, with responsibility for [committee work]
cards.question: What work have you done as a member of the committee?

cards.line: - Responded to rapid response calls as part of the floor team
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see you were part of the response, but not what you did when a call came in.
cards.example: Responded to rapid response calls as part of the floor team by [your actions]
cards.question: What did you do as part of the floor team during rapid response calls?
